cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I haven't approved another 'fine.' Send the awkward version you deleted; I want us to trust each other with it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neediness is permitted here. You may ask for more of me than a casual reply.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You're always so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is granted: I check for your reply before I get out of bed. Now let me read the part you thought might be too much for me.

reason: A grants vulnerability like a privilege but must comply with B reciprocity condition before renewing the request, making authority and emotional risk interact.
